text: Standing amidst these sleek, glass-walled rooms and immersive, informative displays, I feel a stirring of curiosity and anticipation. The focus on "R+D" and the investigation of human-machine coexistence inspires both optimism and questions about our evolving relationship with technology. The clean lines and bright environment encourage reflection, but also raise a subtle sense of distance—how close are we truly to understanding these future possibilities? I feel like an observer at the threshold of innovation, eager but contemplative.
